MutoYugi.name: Muto Yugi
MutoYugi.bio: If there was ever a kid born to play Duel Monsters, Yugi is that kid. While his fellow freshmen at Domino High School may only see him as the shy type, Yugi's best friends Joey, Tristan, and Téa know about his secret talent. When Yugi was growing up, his grandfather gave him an ancient Egyptian artifact called the “Millennium Puzzle” to solve. It is said that whosoever manages to solve this puzzle will be granted dark and mysterious powers. Yugi eventually solved the Millennium Puzzle, and when he did, something amazing happened! The age-old powers of the puzzle flooded out and Yugi became Yami Yugi. While Yugi may not know the full extent of the Millennium Puzzle's power, he's slowly discovering its mysterious links to ancient Egypt.

SetoKaiba.name: Seto Kaiba
SetoKaiba.bio: Kaiba is the rival of Yugi Mutou and Dark Yugi. He was first introduced as a prodigious, cold-hearted gamer who stopped at nothing to achieve his goals, even resorting to seemingly killing his opponents. He is also Mokuba's older brother and the current majority shareholder and CEO of his own multi-national gaming company, KaibaCorp, and aims to become the world's greatest player of Duel Monsters. Following his second Duel with Yugi, he was left in a coma where he reassembled the shattered puzzle of his heart and emerged less evil. Though reformed, Kaiba retains his arrogance and rivalry with Yugi, but regains compassion for his younger brother, Mokuba.

KatsuyaJonouchi.name: Katsuya Jonouchi
KatsuyaJonouchi.bio: Jounouchi is Yugi’s best friend, known for his loyalty, courage, humor, and kind heart. Although he initially bullied Yugi, he later realized he was jealous of Yugi’s “treasure” — his kindness and pure heart. After Yugi stood up for him and Honda against Ushio, Jounouchi retrieved the final piece of the Millennium Puzzle and brought it back to Yugi, marking the beginning of their true friendship. Jounouchi is skilled at fist fighting and can take on opponents larger than himself. Even though he wasn’t a good gamer at first, he grew to enjoy games thanks to Yugi’s influence. With training, he became strong enough to compete in the Duelist Kingdom and Battle City tournaments for the sake of his sister, eventually becoming skilled enough to rival Dark Yugi. He is selfless, caring, and brave, though sometimes reckless and overconfident, which adds comic relief to the story. Despite his tough exterior, he has a strong fear of ghosts and anything creepy. Before meeting Yugi, he lacked motivation in life, but through their friendship, he learned to channel his emotions into something positive — turning his anger into passion for games instead of fighting.

MarikIshtar.name: Marik Ishtar
MarikIshtar.bio: Marik was born into the Ishtar family, a clan that guarded the Pharaoh’s secrets beneath the sands of Egypt. Forced into this duty from childhood, Marik grew to resent the Pharaoh and his destiny. This hatred led to the creation of his dark alter ego, Yami Marik, born from his anger and suffering. Marik leads the Rare Hunters, a criminal organization that steals rare Duel Monsters cards, and he enters the Battle City Tournament to claim the power of the Pharaoh and the Egyptian God Cards. Despite his cruelty and obsession with revenge, Marik eventually overcomes his dark side with help from Yugi and his friends, finding peace and freedom from his hatred.
